jobs.description:
What You'll Be Working OnAt Lime Connect, AI agents already handle customer service conversations for our clients. Now we want to make them better: measurably, and regardless of which language model is currently ahead. That's why we're looking for someone with a backend background who feels at home in the AI world:
• You build and improve our AI agents, from the agent loop and tool calling to context management.
• You set up our architecture so we can switch language models without rebuilding everything.
• Before anything goes live, you use evals to check whether it's actually better. For example, with LLM-as-a-judge and test cases from real customer conversations.
• You turn feedback from the service teams working with our agents into concrete improvements. That way, the system keeps getting better step by step.
• You connect APIs, MCP tools and website crawling, so our agents have the right knowledge and the right tools.
• Within the backend team, you're the go-to person for AI and work closely with Product.

What Makes You a Fit
• Around five years of backend development, including at least a year building language-model features that real users rely on.
• You've built AI agents before and know what context windows, tool calling and prompting mean in practice.
• You've worked hands-on with RAG and vector databases.
• You have experience with evals, for example with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix or LangSmith, or you've built something similar yourself.
• Ideally, you know Pydantic AI, LiteLLM or similar libraries.
• You follow what's happening in AI, try new things quickly and take ownership of your topics.
• You speak German and English fluently.

What’s in It for YouHEALTH & SPORTS
• 600 € health budget per year, including 24/7 medical advice — also for family members in your household
• Subsidised Urban Sports Club membership (20 € monthly contribution)

DEVELOPMENT & GROWTH
• Learning budget for courses, books and conferences
• Free access to Udemy, Masterclass and language learning apps
• Leadership programmes such as "Next Gen" and "Effective Manager"

TEAM & CULTURE
• Weekly FIKA, movie nights, book club and regular get-togethers and team events
• International summer party together with our colleagues in the Nordics

WORK ENVIRONMENT
• Office-first setup: 3 days in our Cologne office at the MediaPark, 2 days remote
• 360° view across Cologne from the 14th floor
• Workation within the EU
• Snacks, cereal bar and drinks in the office

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
• Company pension scheme via Zurich with a 30 % employer contribution
• Job ticket or mobility budget, plus free parking at the MediaPark
• Corporate benefits
• 28 days of holiday, plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off
• Up to 5 days of special leave for important life events

About usAutomated where it makes sense. Personal where it counts.We are Lime Connect – an AI-first company and one of the top software scale-ups in Cologne. AI isn't an add-on for us, it's the core of what we build: our leading customer messaging solution for customer service, sales, and marketing combines AI agents, web chat, and mobile messaging, already automating the majority of all customer inquiries today. As part of Lime Technologies, our Swedish parent company, we combine international perspectives with the drive of a company actively shaping its next stage of growth. With us, you help shape things, not just execute them – with real ownership from day one, in a dynamic environment, and a culture that values results just as much as people. Weekly fika included.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Boehringer Ingelheim's HR function is entering the era of agentic AI. Building on our established AI, we are launching a dedicated Data & AI initiative to reimagine how HR services and processes are delivered across the globe. As Senior AI Expert, you will be the technical and strategic driving force behind this transformation: designing, building and scaling agentic AI solutions that make HR services smarter, faster and more personal for employees, managers and HR experts alike.
You will join the IT Group Functions & Supply Chain (GFS) Global HR Systems team responsible for our core global HR platforms SAP SuccessFactors and act as the central Data & AI lead for the wider IT GFS Human Resources organization, partnering closely with Corporate HR Centers of Excellence, GBS Process Management, HR stakeholders in the countries and other IT functions like the IT Enterprise Service Management team bringing ServiceNow to the center of HR Service Management.
Tasks & responsibilities

- Own and drive the Data & AI initiative for HR: define the roadmap, prioritize use cases and lead the transition of HR services and processes towards agentic, AI-first ways of working.
- Design, build and industrialize agentic AI solutions and multi-step AI workflows for HR processes using platforms such as SAP Business AI/ SAPJoule, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Dify, ServiceNow Now Assist and more.
- Define and safeguard the data foundation for AI in HR: identify and prioritize HR "crown jewel" datasets, drive onboarding of AI-/agentic-AI-ready data products, and ensure data quality, semantics and governance meet the requirements of generative and agentic AI use cases.
- Establish and champion agentic AI governance for HR in line with BI's enterprise Responsible AI frameworks: agent lifecycle and ownership, permissions and data boundaries, human oversight, monitoring, and audit readiness.
- Build the business case, cost/benefit assessment and prioritization matrix for AI use cases in HR and translate them into a concrete execution roadmap with measurable business outcomes.

Requirements

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Human Resources, or a related field, or a Bachelor's degree with more professional experience.
- Several years of experience in AI and data-driven solution design, ideally combined with exposure to HR technology, HR processes, or HR IT landscapes within a global organization.
- Proven experience leading or significantly contributing to AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives from ideation through implementation and scaling.
- Hands-on experience with SAP Business AI and SAP Joule, including embedded AI capabilities across SAP SuccessFactors and the ability to configure, extend, and govern AI solutions.
- Practical knowledge of agentic AI concepts and platforms, including low-code/no-code and code-based AI development environments.
- Understanding of AI data foundations, including data products, data quality, semantic and metadata management, and familiarity with enterprise data and AI ecosystems.
- Familiarity with HR technology landscapes such as SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, Degreed, Payroll, and Time Management systems.
- Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, combined with strategic thinking, a hands-on approach, experience working across global and cross-functional teams, intercultural awareness
- Fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You lead the commodity agenda for a commodity for Large Steam and Syncon products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Steam and Syncon portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy
* Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end-to-end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations
* Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Steam and Syncon demand
* Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area
* Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures
* Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond

What You Bring

* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting
* Familiarity with heavy industry products. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key
* Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modelling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact-based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management
* Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.) 
* Professional fluency in German & Englisch required for stakeholder and supplier interactions; Willingness to travel (~10–20%) for supplier visits and cross site collaboration

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder under very attractive employee conditions
* Under our motto #BetterTogether, we offer flexible and remote working options, as well as modern office spaces that foster collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We offer various programs and initiatives to support self-directed learning and developmentTo support work-life balance, we offer a wide range of benefits, such as flexible working time models, childcare options at many locations, trial part-time arrangements, and sabbaticals
* We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Our facilities in Bocholt have recently been expanded to include a CAE Full-Flight Simulator for the King Air B200 equipped with a Pro Line 21 cockpit. A second simulator is already in the planning stage.

The simulator provides a highly realistic representation of the aircraft and is certified to the highest qualification standard, Level D. This gives BLISSAIR a unique market position, as it is the only simulator of its kind in Europe.

- Good computer skills, particularly with Windows operating systems and older computer hardware
- Good IT skills, basic network setup and understanding of network protocols.

- Ability to work independently with a high level of personal responsibility.
- Knowledge of C++ programming language and experience in the aviation industry are an advantage.
- Fluent in spoken and written english
- Quick learner with strong teamwork skills, initiative, and enthusiasm.
- Strong interest in technical systems and aviation industry

Your Responsibilities

- Work as part of the simulator maintenance team.
- Independently perform maintenance and servicing of simulator hardware, including quality checks.
- Provide technical support during customer training operations.
- Analyze and diagnose faults, carry out repairs.
- Document maintenance activities, inspections, and quality checks.

- A friendly working environment in a small team with an open, collaborative culture and flat hierarchies.
- A responsible and varied role with exciting technical challenges.
- The opportunity to work on a unique Level D King Air B200 simulator—the only one of its kind in Europe.

- The chance to contribute to internal process improvements and help plan and implement the company's second simulator.

Introduction

INM is an internationally leading centre for interdisciplinary research on (bio)hybrid materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological processes, physical analysis, and process engineering. We aim for leadership in the fields of opto-interactive, electro-integrative and bio-intelligent material systems. In these areas, we actively seize opportunities to transfer our scientific results into materials-driven innovation.

The INM research group, Bioprogrammable Materials, is looking for an enthusiastic Post-Doctoral Researcher with experience in microbial biotechnology and adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE). We combine synthetic biology, microbial engineering and sustainable materials research to develop innovative solutions for industrial and environmental challenges. We are seeking to fill a 2-year funded Post-Doctoral Researcher position as part of an Industrially-aligned European project developing sustainable biobased coatings. The role at INM focuses on identifying and ehancingmicrobes capable of degrading the polymeric coatings, thereby enabling future circularity and end-of-life strategies.

Identify microbes capable of degrading bio-based polymeric materials
Establish screening platforms to evaluate microbial degradation performance
Apply adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) to improve degradation efficiency and substrate utilization
Characterize evolved strains using microbiological and molecular biology techniques
Collaborate closely with industrial and academic project partners
Contribute to project reporting, scientific publications and conference presentations
Actively participate in the research activities of the group
We are seeking a person with a doctoral degree in biotechnology, biochemistry, microbiology or related fields, with practical experience in adaptive lab evolution. The candidate will be part of an international, multi-disciplinary team in which English is the primary language of communication and reporting. Since we work on application-oriented research, candidates with entrepreneurial interests are appreciated.

A 2-year E13 TV-L 100% contract.
A dynamic, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with excellent, state-of-the-art infrastructure.
A cooperative, friendly and supportive environment, with plenty of opportunities to interact with other researchers, also outside the team and the institute.
The opportunity for training to support high-quality research and to further develop your profile.

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Neuronal exocytosis is a highly regulated process that enables the rapid release of neurotransmitters from synaptic vesicles. Central to this process is the controlled assembly of SNARE protein complexes, which drive membrane fusion and are regulated by a network of associated proteins. The PhD project will investigate the structural and molecular mechanisms underlying SNARE complex assembly and function in membrane-like environments. A particular focus will be placed on the development and characterization of membrane-mimetic systems, including lipid nanodiscs and synthetic copolymers, to study SNARE complexes and their regulatory proteins under increasingly native-like conditions. Cryo-electron microscopy will be combined with complementary biochemical and biophysical approaches to characterize these systems at the molecular level.
The project offers the opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary structural biology environment at Forschungszentrum Jülich, with access to expertise in cryo-EM, NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography. Cryo-EM studies will be conducted at the state-of-the-art facilities of the Ernst Ruska-Centre (ER-C) at Forschungszentrum Jülich. The expertise in NMR spectroscopy and macromolecular crystallography at IBI-7 offers further opportunities for complementary structural and biophysical characterization. This combination of methods will enable the candidate to address biological questions from different structural perspectives and to develop a broad expertise in modern structural biology. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:

A Master’s degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, structural biology, or a related field

Strong practical experience in protein biochemistry, including recombinant protein expression and purification
Previous hands-on experience with cryo-electron microscopy and/or cryo-EM sample preparation
Interest in membrane proteins, protein-protein interactions and structural biology
Ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary research team
Good communication skills in English

jobs.description:
Overview:

Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.

For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. 

Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.

Unit’s description and purpose: 

The Global Impact unit strengthens the Fairtrade system by driving institutional learning and effectiveness through robust monitoring and evaluation systems. We are the hub for the analysis and communication of high-quality data and information about Fairtrade and its impact, as well as supporting strategy delivery. The unit includes the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) team, which is the Fairtrade system’s hub for MEL which directly connects evidence to strategic decision for the Global Strategy, individual Fairtrade projects and global programmes, Standards, producer support, and more.

PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Role purpose: 

The Impact Portfolio Manager (Fairer Futures Programmes) is responsible for stewarding the MEL frameworks for several of Fairtrade’s global product programmes, the flagship programmatic vehicles through which Fairtrade delivers measurable impact for farmers and workers under its 2026–2028 Global Strategy. 

The manager will share responsibilities for a total of three programmes (cocoa, banana, coffee) with another manager, with product- and thematic-specific focus to be determined upon hire.

Working in close collaboration with Fairtrade Producer Networks, Global Product Teams, and the Digital Service Unit, the role ensures that both programmes are underpinned by robust, coherent, and actionable MEL, from framework design through data collection, reporting, evaluation, and learning. The position serves as one of Fairtrade International's primary MEL contact across programme discussions, representing the Global Impact unit in a system that spans FI, National Fairtrade Organizations, and Producer Networks. This role also contributes to the Global Impact unit's impact services offer, drawing on programme MEL expertise to identify and develop customized services for the Fairtrade system and external partners.

Main Responsibilities:            

- MEL Framework, Indicators, and Data Management. Steward and drive the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Theory of Change and MEL framework for several of the Fairer Futures Programmes, working in close collaboration with Producer Networks and Global Product Teams. Steward the KPI and activity/output indicator set for both programmes, including maintaining metadata and monitoring data quality. Work with PN MEL staff, Global Product Teams, and where needed external consultants to ensure systematic consolidation of existing programme data and the design and implementation of regular data collection processes. Coordinate with the Information & Knowledge team on data cleaning, analysis, and visualisation.
- Stakeholder Engagement and Project MEL Alignment. Serve as Fairtrade International's primary MEL contact for the product-expert colleagues in Producer Networks and Global Product Teams, providing technical MEL guidance, supporting capacity on data collection and reporting, and ensuring programme MEL requirements are understood and operationalised across the system. Work with PNs to ensure that MEL frameworks for individual projects within both programme portfolios are aligned to the overarching programme frameworks, providing where capacity is available guidance and quality assurance at project inception and during implementation
- Reporting, Synthesis, and Learning. Lead the preparation of programme-level MEL reporting for programmes, synthesising data and evidence from across the programme portfolio into outputs that feed into the overall strategy reporting cycle. Facilitate learning processes within programmes, identifying evidence-based insights and working with Global Product Teams and PNs to support programme adaptation where warranted. Ensure programme MEL evidence and KPI data are appropriately integrated into the overall strategy MEL cycle in close coordination with the designated strategy MEL lead within the Impact Management team.
- Programme Evaluation. Lead the design, commissioning, and management of the programme evaluations. This includes developing evaluation questions in collaboration with PNs and Global Product Teams, overseeing evaluation partners, and ensuring findings are translated into actionable learning.
- Impact Services and External Engagement. Identify opportunities to offer MEL technical services to Fairtrade system organisations and external partners, drawing on expertise developed through the programmes. Contribute to the scoping, design, and pitching of impact services in collaboration with the Head, with a particular focus on programme MEL, data collection design, and evaluation. Participate actively in relevant system-wide working groups, representing the Impact Management team's MEL perspective on cross-organisational initiatives.

Other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.

SKILLS REQUIRED:

Level of education: The position holder will have a Master’s degree or higher in development economics, econometrics, applied sociology, social sciences or another relevant field in management or natural sciences. 

Years of professional experience: A minimum of five years' experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning, with demonstrable experience designing and managing MEL frameworks for multi-stakeholder projects or programmes. At least two years' experience working in or with stakeholders from the Global South, preferably in agricultural or commodity supply chain contexts. Experience in coffee and bananas is an advantage.

Language requirements: Fluency in English required. Professional proficiency in Spanish is a advantage. 

Job Specific Competencies/knowledge:
